items.title: What Should Qualcomm (QCOM) Investors Watch After 500 California Layoffs And New AI Moves?
items.summary: Qualcomm (NasdaqGS:QCOM) is cutting more than 500 jobs in California as it reshapes operations under pressure in its smartphone business. The company is reallocating resources toward new AI inference initiatives, backed by fresh technology partnerships announced in recent months. Qualcomm is also extending its reach into K-8 robotics education through programs built with Arduino, Disney Imagineering, and REV Robotics. items.title: Inside Brad Gerstner’s Portfolio: Every Move He Made in the Third Quarter
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBrad Gerstner’s Altimeter Capital opened a $680 million Tesla position in the third quarter, added to Meta Platforms and Micron, and sold out of Qualcomm and Applied Materials. Tesla trades at about 180x forward earnings, and analysts’ average target is just 7% above the price, so the new stake is a bet on Robotaxi profits that the estimates don’t show yet.

items.title: Arm Just Dropped 21% in a Month. Will ARM Stock Hit $150 or $200 First?
items.summary: Arm has shed a fifth of its value in a month, leaving bulls and bears staring at two very different price levels. A stretched valuation, defensive options bets, and a surprisingly strong pipeline all collide in the fight over where shares head next.
